scenes.narration: Welcome to the 2026 Annual Business Performance Review. Let's dive into our results for the year.
scenes.title: 2026 Annual Business Performance Review
scenes.subtitle: Driving Growth and Achievement

scenes.narration: For the entire year of 2026, our total revenue reached an impressive 806.9 Crores, exceeding our target by a significant 23.0 Crores. This translates to an overall achievement of 103.0%.

Looking at our monthly performance, we see a consistent upward trend in revenue throughout the year. While we saw some minor fluctuations, the overall trajectory shows healthy growth and strong performance, consistently meeting or exceeding targets in the latter half.
scenes.title: Monthly Revenue Performance (Jan-Dec 2026)

scenes.narration: Now let's break down the performance by region. The West and South regions were outstanding, significantly surpassing their revenue targets, while North and East faced some challenges.
scenes.title: Total Revenue by Region (2026)

scenes.narration: The West region was our top performer, generating 296.2 Crores in revenue. They achieved a remarkable 108.9% of their target, resulting in a positive variance of 24.5 Crores. Excellent work, West team!

Conversely, the North region generated 191.0 Crores, but fell short of its target, achieving 95.3%. This led to a variance of negative 9.5 Crores. We need to analyze the specific factors impacting this region and develop strategies for improvement.
Shifting our focus to product performance, Industrial Motors significantly outperformed its targets, while Pumps faced headwinds, ending the year below its set objectives.
scenes.title: Product Performance: Actual vs. Target Revenue (2026)

scenes.narration: Industrial Motors truly drove our success, with 486.2 Crores in revenue, achieving an impressive 109.4% of its target, and generating a positive variance of 41.6 Crores. This product line continues to be a strong pillar for our business.

However, our Pumps product line generated 320.7 Crores, falling short with an achievement of 94.5% and a negative variance of 18.6 Crores. This area requires strategic attention to understand market dynamics and improve performance.

In summary, 2026 was a year of strong overall revenue growth, driven primarily by our West and South regions and the Industrial Motors product. We also identified key areas for improvement in the North and East regions and for our Pumps product line. Thank you.
scenes.title: Key Takeaways & Next Steps
scenes.subtitle: Leverage strengths, address challenges for 2027
